name: Flax
note: Flax, Linum usitatissimum (F1, Matt's call of October 30, 2026: cloth comes from flax on the meadow islet, not nettles): slender upright stems with narrow leaves, each carrying a few flat sky-blue five-petal flowers that open in the morning in high summer, then round seed bolls; the stems turn straw-yellow toward autumn, the time to pull them. Old crofts on machair grew it on the richer patches. A machair plant of the meadow islet (recipes/land/meadow-islet.json starters, its waiting slot): it comes only with the islet, planted on its grassy patches when it rises, and spreads from there by seed; not in the volunteers' order and not offered by the Plant tool (plantTool false). The walker pulls its stems (recipes/world/gather.json flax.stems), steeps the bundle in a pond (src/world/gather/retting.js) and weaves the fibre into cloth at the workbench (recipes/world/cook.json cloth). Drawn with the thrift shader (draw: thrift; flora-thrift.wgsl): its keys are the thrift's (see chamomile.json's note for head forms); a tall narrow cushion of fine blades stands for the leafy stems, the flowers ride a little above it. drawScale: drawn this many times real size, so it can be found (the shape numbers already include it). habitat: shoreM is height above mean sea level; sand the painted sand share (flax keeps to the grassy patches, where the turf has closed over the shell sand). season: the stems' albedo per season (linear), straw in autumn.

phenology.note: each plant keeps its own calendar, offset from the species by up to jitterDays game days either way (hash of the plant id; src/world/growth/phenology.js)
